metadata.description: Maps major iPhone electronic components to their direct and indirect supplier chains. Direct supplier = sells the component or service directly to Apple. Indirect supplier = supplies materials, equipment, or sub-components to a direct supplier.
sources: Nikkei Asia semiconductor supply chain reporting
Company annual reports and SEC/stock-exchange filings

relationship_confidence_legend.confirmed: Appears in Apple Supplier Responsibility Report or company SEC/exchange filing
relationship_confidence_legend.strong_indication: Multiple credible industry sources corroborate the relationship
relationship_confidence_legend.inferred: Logical inference based on known technology stack and known fab/material relationships

components.description: Apple-designed ARM-based system-on-chip integrating CPU, GPU, Neural Engine, ISP, and Secure Enclave. Apple designs the chip internally; TSMC is the exclusive foundry partner.

direct_suppliers.role: Sole foundry for Apple Silicon; fabricates A-series chips on 3nm process nodes

indirect_suppliers.role: Sole global supplier of EUV lithography machines required for sub-7nm chip fabrication
Supplies CVD, PVD, and CMP equipment critical to semiconductor wafer processing
Supplies etch and deposition systems for advanced logic fabs
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Plasma etch and CVD/ALD deposition equipment

indirect_suppliers.role: Process control and inspection equipment for semiconductor fabs
World's largest silicon wafer manufacturer; supplies polished 300mm wafers
Manufactures flip-chip BGA substrates used to package Apple Silicon chips

components.notes: Apple designs the A-series chip internally (Apple Silicon team). TSMC is the exclusive manufacturing partner. Apple is the IP owner and does not appear as a supplier in this schema.

components.description: Flexible OLED panels with ProMotion (120Hz adaptive) on Pro models. Covered by Corning Ceramic Shield glass on the front. Suppliers vary by model tier.
apple_part_numbers: Super Retina XDR OLED (all iPhone 15/16 models)

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of OLED panels; supplies both standard and ProMotion OLED panels
Secondary supplier of OLED panels for iPhone
Tertiary supplier of OLED panels; primarily for base iPhone models

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies Ceramic Shield and Gorilla Glass for display cover glass
Supplies optical films and polarizers used in OLED panel construction
Licenses phosphorescent OLED (PHOLED) materials and technology to panel makers
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Phosphorescent OLED emitter materials and technology licenses

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies organic light-emitting materials and liquid crystals for OLED displays
Supplies polarizing films and OLED functional materials

components.description: Stacked backside-illuminated (BSI) CMOS image sensors. Primary camera uses a large-format sensor on Pro models. Sony is the dominant supplier.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of stacked BSI CMOS image sensors for all cameras
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: CMOS image sensors (Exmor RS stacked BSI)

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates logic tier of Sony's stacked image sensors when Sony outsources wafer capacity
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Logic wafer fabrication for stacked sensor architecture

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies silicon wafers to Sony Semiconductor fabs

components.description: Precision plastic aspheric lens elements grouped into lens assemblies for main, ultrawide, and telephoto cameras. Largan Precision is the dominant supplier.

direct_suppliers.role: Dominant supplier of precision plastic aspheric lenses (~70-80% share of Apple camera lenses)
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Precision plastic aspheric lens elements and assemblies

direct_suppliers.role: Secondary supplier of camera lens assemblies

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies cyclo-olefin polymer (COP/COC) resins used to mold precision optical lens elements
Supplies specialty optical-grade plastic resins for lens molding

components.description: Complete camera modules integrating image sensor, lens assembly, OIS actuator, and autofocus mechanism. LG Innotek is the primary supplier for high-end modules.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of complete camera modules including periscope telephoto for Pro models
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Complete camera modules (main, ultra-wide, periscope tele)

direct_suppliers.role: Secondary supplier of camera modules for standard iPhone models

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies lens assemblies integrated into camera modules
Supplies CMOS image sensors integrated into camera modules
Supplies voice coil motor (VCM) actuators for autofocus and OIS mechanisms
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Voice coil motor (VCM) actuators for autofocus and OIS

indirect_suppliers.role: Subsidiary of Mitsumi Electric (acquired by Minebea Mitsumi); supplies actuator components for OIS

components.description: Custom-shaped lithium-ion polymer battery packs. ATL is the primary supplier. Battery life is a key spec differentiator across iPhone generations.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of lithium-ion polymer battery cells and assembled packs; subsidiary of TDK
Secondary supplier of lithium-ion battery packs
Tertiary battery supplier for some iPhone models

indirect_suppliers.role: Parent company of ATL; provides technical oversight and some material inputs
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Battery materials and technology via ATL ownership

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies lithium hydroxide and lithium carbonate used in cathode active materials
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Lithium hydroxide and lithium carbonate (cathode precursor)

indirect_suppliers.role: Global lithium producer; supplies lithium compounds for battery cathode materials
Supplies cathode active materials (NMC) for lithium-ion batteries
Manufactures battery separator films via its Celgard subsidiary

components.description: 3D NAND flash memory for iPhone internal storage (128GB to 1TB options). Multiple suppliers used across product lines.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary NAND flash supplier; formerly Toshiba Memory; supplies 3D NAND (BiCS FLASH)
Secondary NAND flash supplier
Tertiary NAND flash supplier (V-NAND)

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies DUV/EUV lithography equipment to all NAND fabs for patterning
Supplies etch equipment critical for high-aspect-ratio 3D NAND channel hole etching
Joint venture partner with Kioxia; co-develops and co-manufactures NAND flash at shared fabs in Japan
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Co-manufacturing via Kioxia JV (shared fab capacity)

components.description: Low-power DRAM (LPDDR5/LPDDR5X) packaged as part of the PoP (Package-on-Package) or integrated into the SoC package. All iPhone 15/16 series use 6-8GB RAM.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary LPDDR5/LPDDR5X DRAM supplier for iPhone
Secondary LPDDR5 DRAM supplier
Tertiary LPDDR5 DRAM supplier

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies EUV lithography equipment used in advanced DRAM node production
Supplies specialty chemicals, filtration, and materials management systems for DRAM fabs
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Specialty chemicals, filtration systems, and contamination control materials

components.description: 5G modem handling cellular connectivity. Qualcomm supplies the primary modem for iPhone 15/16. Apple's in-house C1 modem debuted in iPhone 16e (2025) and is expected to gradually replace Qualcomm.

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies Snapdragon X70/X75 5G modem-RF system for iPhone 15 and 16 series

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates Qualcomm Snapdragon modem chips and Apple's in-house C1 modem on advanced nodes
Supplies RF modules and passive components that accompany the modem chipset
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: RF modules, SAW/BAW filters, and passive components

components.notes: Apple's in-house C1 modem (fabbed by TSMC) debuted in iPhone 16e in 2025. Apple is expected to phase out Qualcomm modems gradually across the iPhone line.

components.description: Combo chip handling Wi-Fi 6E/7, Bluetooth 5.3, and Ultra Wideband (UWB). Apple has been developing in-house wireless chips (W-series, U1/U2) while also using Broadcom for Wi-Fi/BT.

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies Wi-Fi / Bluetooth combo chips integrated in iPhone; major Apple revenue contributor
Packages Wi-Fi/BT chips into RF modules; supplies Wi-Fi front-end modules

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates Broadcom Wi-Fi/BT chips and Apple's W-series/U-series wireless chips

components.description: Power amplifiers, band-pass filters (SAW/BAW), switches, and antenna tuning modules that condition RF signals for cellular transmission and reception across sub-6GHz and mmWave bands.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of power amplifier modules and RF switches for cellular bands
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: RF power amplifier modules, antenna switches

direct_suppliers.role: Secondary supplier of power amplifiers, BAW filters, and antenna tuning modules
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: RF power amplifiers, BAW filters, antenna tuning modules

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies SAW and BAW filters, RF modules for cellular front end
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: SAW/BAW RF filters and front-end modules

indirect_suppliers.role: GaAs compound semiconductor foundry; fabricates power amplifier wafers for Skyworks and Qorvo
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: GaAs and GaN wafer fabrication for RF power amplifiers

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies GaAs epitaxial wafers to compound semiconductor foundries
Supplies thin-film BAW filter technology components and passive components for RF front end
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: BAW filter components and RF passive components

components.description: Controls power delivery to all iPhone subsystems, manages battery charging, and regulates voltages. Apple has been developing in-house PMICs fabricated by TSMC.

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies main PMIC via its Dialog Semiconductor subsidiary (acquired 2021)
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Power management ICs (via Dialog Semiconductor brand)

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies battery charging management ICs and secondary power management functions
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Battery charger ICs and DC-DC converter ICs

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates Apple-designed in-house PMIC chips and Dialog PMIC chips on advanced nodes
Alternative foundry used by Texas Instruments for some PMIC products

components.description: The TrueDepth camera system projects 30,000+ infrared dots via a dot projector VCSEL, reads the pattern with an infrared camera, and uses a flood illuminator for low-light. Enables Face ID biometric authentication and Animoji.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of VCSEL arrays for the dot projector in Face ID
Secondary supplier of VCSEL arrays for Face ID dot projector
Supplies flood illuminator (IR LED), proximity sensor, and ambient light sensor in TrueDepth module
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: IR flood illuminator LEDs, proximity sensors

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies compound semiconductor (GaAs/InGaP) epitaxial wafers used to produce VCSELs
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Compound semiconductor epitaxial wafers for VCSEL production

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies the infrared image sensor used in the TrueDepth camera for Face ID

components.description: Comprises an audio codec/DAC-amp IC (Cirrus Logic), micro-speakers for earpiece and bottom-firing speaker (AAC Technologies), and MEMS microphones (Knowles, GoerTek).

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies audio codec and DAC/amplifier chips; Apple represents ~80% of Cirrus Logic revenue
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Audio codec, DAC, and amplifier ICs

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies micro-speakers (earpiece receiver and bottom-firing speaker)
Primary supplier of MEMS microphones for iPhone
Secondary supplier of MEMS microphones and acoustic components

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates Cirrus Logic audio chips on advanced CMOS process nodes

components.description: Near-field communication controller enabling Apple Pay, transit cards, digital keys, and peer-to-peer data sharing. NXP Semiconductors is the sole confirmed supplier.

direct_suppliers.role: Sole supplier of NFC controller chip (PN series) for iPhone; also supplies Secure Element
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: NFC controller IC and Secure Element

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates NXP's NFC controller chips
Secondary foundry used by NXP for some chip variants

components.description: MEMS-based inertial sensors enabling step counting, screen rotation, gaming, and Crash Detection. Barometer enables elevation tracking and emergency features.

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies 6-axis IMU (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope) and barometric pressure sensor
Supplies gyroscope and possibly barometer (InvenSense acquired by TDK in 2017; confirmed Apple Supplier)

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies MEMS deposition and etch equipment to STMicroelectronics MEMS fabs
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Semiconductor manufacturing equipment for MEMS fabs

components.description: Ambient light sensor auto-adjusts display brightness; proximity sensor detects when the phone is held to the ear to turn off the display. Both are on the front face. ams OSRAM is the confirmed sole supplier.

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies ambient light sensor and proximity sensor (confirmed sole supplier for multiple generations)
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Ambient light sensor IC and proximity sensor (IR-based)

indirect_suppliers.role: Fabricates ams OSRAM sensor ICs on CMOS process nodes
Supplies IR LED emitters used in proximity sensing

components.description: Linear resonant actuator (LRA) providing precise haptic feedback. Apple's Taptic Engine delivers fine-grained haptic patterns for notifications, keyboard typing, and UI interactions.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of linear resonant actuators (LRA) for Taptic Engine
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Linear resonant actuator (LRA) components for Taptic Engine

direct_suppliers.role: Secondary supplier of precision vibration motors and LRA actuators

indirect_suppliers.role: Major producer of NdFeB (neodymium-iron-boron) rare earth permanent magnets used in LRA actuators
US-based rare earth miner and processor; supplies neodymium and praseodymium for magnets
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Rare earth materials (NdPr) for permanent magnets

components.description: The main logic board PCB and the advanced IC package substrates (ABF substrates) that package Apple Silicon chips. High-density interconnect (HDI) PCBs are used for compact iPhone layouts.

direct_suppliers.role: Dominant supplier of ABF (Ajinomoto Build-up Film) package substrates for Apple Silicon; confirmed Apple Supplier
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Flip-chip BGA and IC package substrates

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies HDI PCBs and IC substrates for iPhone main logic board
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: HDI PCBs and IC package substrates

direct_suppliers.role: Supplies high-density interconnect (HDI) PCBs for iPhone; confirmed Apple Supplier
Supplies flexible printed circuits (FPC) used extensively throughout iPhone for connectors and antennas

indirect_suppliers.role: Sole supplier of ABF (Ajinomoto Build-up Film) insulating material that gives Ibiden substrates their name
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: ABF insulating resin film for IC package substrates

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies MEGTRON high-speed laminate materials used in high-frequency PCB layers

components.description: Precision CNC-machined aluminum (standard) or titanium (Pro) chassis, with anodized finish. Final assembly integrates all components. iPhone 15+ uses titanium frames for Pro and aluminum for standard models.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary final assembly contractor; Zhengzhou facility (China) is the world's largest iPhone factory
Secondary final assembly contractor; facilities in Shanghai and Indonesia
Tertiary and growing assembly partner; also supplies connectors and cables
Primary CNC machining supplier for aluminum and titanium iPhone chassis
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: CNC-machined aluminum and titanium chassis / enclosures

direct_suppliers.role: Secondary metal enclosure supplier; subsidiary of Pegatron

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies high-strength aerospace-grade aluminum alloy sheet (subsidiary of Hindalco Industries)
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy sheet stock for CNC machining

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies titanium alloy used in iPhone 15/16 Pro titanium frame (alternative to Russian VSMPO-AVISMA post-2022)
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Titanium alloy for Pro model chassis

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies structural adhesives and thermal interface materials used in iPhone assembly
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Structural adhesives, thermal interface materials, underfill materials

components.notes: Titanium supply chain for Pro models is sensitive to geopolitical factors. Prior to 2022 Russia sanctions, VSMPO-AVISMA was a major titanium supplier to the aerospace/consumer electronics supply chain. Apple and its assemblers have diversified to US (ATI), Japanese, and other sources.

components.description: USB-C port introduced in iPhone 15 (replacing Lightning). Supports USB 3.2 Gen 2 speeds on Pro models and USB 2.0 on standard models. Also used for MagSafe-based charging via separate induction coil assembly.

direct_suppliers.role: Primary supplier of USB-C connectors for iPhone 15/16 series
Secondary supplier of USB-C connectors and cable assemblies
Supplies precision connector contact components for USB-C

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies beryllium copper alloy strip used for high-cycle, high-conductivity connector spring contacts
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Beryllium copper alloy for connector spring contacts

components.description: Synthetic sapphire (single-crystal Al2O3) used as the hard protective cover over camera lenses due to its extreme scratch resistance (Mohs 9). Also used for the rear camera flash lens cover.

direct_suppliers.role: US-based grower and polisher of synthetic sapphire boules for optical windows
direct_suppliers.what_they_supply: Synthetic sapphire optical windows (camera lens cover)

direct_suppliers.role: Chinese sapphire crystal grower and polisher supplying cover windows at scale

indirect_suppliers.role: Provides sapphire polishing, precision cutting, and finishing services for optical components
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: Sapphire polishing and precision optical finishing

indirect_suppliers.role: Supplies high-purity alumina (Al2O3) powder — the raw material from which synthetic sapphire crystals are grown
indirect_suppliers.what_they_supply: High-purity alumina raw material for sapphire crystal growing
